datasets.name: recent_workouts
queryLines:
SELECT
  local_date,
  activity,
  start_local,
  duration_min,
  distance_km,
  avg_speed_kmh,
  active_kcal,
  hr_avg,
  hr_max,
  elevation_gain_m,
  weather_temp_c
FROM
  gold_workouts
ORDER BY
  start_local DESC
LIMIT 50

config.source: SELECT local_date, year, month, day_of_week, is_weekend, steps, walk_run_km, cycling_km, active_kcal, basal_kcal, flights_climbed, exercise_min, stand_min, daylight_min, hr_mean, hr_min, hr_max, resting_hr, walking_hr_avg, hrv_sdnn_ms, spo2_pct, respiratory_rate, vo2max, body_mass_kg, bmi, walking_speed_kmh, step_length_cm, walking_asymmetry_pct, double_support_pct, n_workouts, workout_min, workout_kcal, training_load, CAST(move_ring_closed AS INT) AS move_ring_closed, CAST(exercise_ring_closed AS INT) AS exercise_ring_closed, CAST(stand_ring_closed AS INT) AS stand_ring_closed, DATE_TRUNC('month', local_date) AS year_month, AVG(steps) OVER (ORDER BY local_date ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS steps_7d, AVG(steps) OVER (ORDER BY local_date ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS steps_28d, AVG(resting_hr) OVER (ORDER BY local_date ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS resting_hr_28d, AVG(hrv_sdnn_ms) OVER (ORDER BY local_date ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS hrv_28d, AVG(walking_speed_kmh) OVER (ORDER BY local_date ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS walking_speed_28d, AVG(step_length_cm) OVER (ORDER BY local_date ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS step_length_28d, AVG(walking_asymmetry_pct) OVER (ORDER BY local_date ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS asymmetry_28d, AVG(body_mass_kg) OVER (ORDER BY local_date ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS body_mass_28d, AVG(bmi) OVER (ORDER BY local_date ROWS BETWEEN 27 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS bmi_28d FROM gold_daily_summary
SELECT local_date, local_hour, DAYOFWEEK(local_date) AS day_of_week, value FROM gold_hourly_activity WHERE metric = 'StepCount'
SELECT local_date, local_hour, DATE_TRUNC('month', local_date) AS year_month, hr_mean FROM gold_hourly_heart_rate
